decides: Input answer = PreferredInput if the property reads and its changed signal fires when the device in use changes. If it errors, fall back to LastInputTypeChanged mapped to three classes with a 0.5 s hold. Arrangement (TouchDrive) stays TouchEnabled either way. Two cases still need real hardware or the device emulator: a touch laptop (expect TouchEnabled = true, PreferredInput = KeyboardAndMouse until the screen is touched) and a phone with a gamepad (expect PreferredInput = Gamepad after a button press, TouchEnabled still true).
needsCapture: none (data only). Record which device or emulator profile the run used.
lastInputTypeChurn: count of LastInputType lines against PreferredInput lines shows why Input reads PreferredInput (plan 3.1)
